title: Needs Another Pass
body:
Some surfaces are going to take a little more work.

One pass might not be enough.

![A close-up of a suspended blue car door at 54.1% clean, with an abrasive sponge held against the panel and patches of embedded oxide stain still visible.](../media/code-review-simulator-2026-07-16-needs-another-pass/mid-cleaning-scrub.png)

![A dark garage restoration bay with a rusted car door hanging from chains and an abrasive sponge waiting on a workbench beneath the Oxide Bay 07 sign.](../media/code-review-simulator-2026-07-16-needs-another-pass/garage-overview.png)
